title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Education: Advancing Adaptive and Personalized Learning

live_model.evidence: Descriptive/conceptual review of generative-AI architectures and adaptive-learning benefits (Tables 1-5); only generic 'turbo-level' phrase found, no gpt-4-turbo experiment run by the authors.

notes: This is a conceptual/narrative review of generative AI in education (architectures, historical timeline, benefits tables); it reports no original model runs or accuracy numbers.
